mandatoryCriteria: Descriptions and every normalized import field survive parser, preview persistence, mapping, commit and duplicate hashing without silent data loss. Existing accepted API/MCP priority compatibility remains separate from UI explicit selection.

Separately previewed copies of one external ID cannot create duplicate logical cards. Commit atomically rechecks/claims durable board/external-ID identity before card effects; identical content yields safe existing outcome, changed content conflicts, failures roll back marker/card/activity/receipt together.

Import assignee eligibility intersects active writable project role with current target board grant (Owner inheritance allowed). Preview and commit reject hidden/removed/ineligible accounts without leaking unrelated identities; revocation serializes with commit.

Preview mapping and commit bind actual normalized row hashes, assignments, exact board/column context and structural revision. No placeholder digest or unpreviewed commit-time override can silently change the authorized preview.

Accept genuine supported Excel dates and strict Gregorian text only. Arbitrary general numeric cells cannot become dates merely because their values look like serials. Macro/formula/link/ZIP/decompression/image safety remains enforced.

Cancel/expiry/purge safely remove private staged row descriptions/titles/emails and copied report data within the specified retention window while preserving minimal retry/audit/duplicate facts. Scheduled cleanup is wired, bounded, retryable and cannot scrub another project's still-authorized active operation.

Any new migration is additive and tested for clean/upgrade/idempotent behavior; Worker embedded SQL matches exact filesystem bytes. Legacy records are handled conservatively without inventing lost content or silently overwriting existing cards.

Mounted PostgreSQL tests exercise nonempty descriptions, identical/different external-ID separate previews and real competing connections, grant changes, stale previews/overrides, numeric/date styles and cleanup boundaries. Historical failed reproductions are preserved. Fresh independent review on the final full-product target is required before any feature closes.
scopeLimits: Synthetic disposable PostgreSQL on localhost55931 only. No production/cloud/credentials/deployment. Builder owns imports/excel parser/import retention and necessary migrations, not identity notifications/member files or UI. This bounded repair is not full-product approval.
